about: Muthoot Finance Limited, a non-banking financing company, provides gold loans in India. The company offers various loans, including personal, small business, home, corporate business, SME, and vehicle loans, as well as loans against property; insurance products, such as health, home, vehicle, life, travel, shop, bike, and group insurance; housing and micro finance; and mutual funds.
